name: auditin72
description: Audit a public website for SEO, performance, accessibility, usability and technical issues, with evidence, scores and prioritized fixes. Provided by SiteIn72.

interface.longDescription: Audit a public website from its URL and get an evidence-based report covering technical SEO, on-page SEO, performance and Core Web Vitals, accessibility, mobile usability, conversion journeys, security hygiene, and content quality. Review category scores alongside test coverage, inspect the evidence behind each finding, and follow prioritized fixes with severity, impact, effort estimates, and retest criteria. Compare targeted repairs with broader redesign needs and recheck completed fixes. Uses a consistent 40-check method and the browsing and inspection tools available in the conversation. Checks without sufficient evidence are marked untested; performance metrics require actual measurements. Provided by SiteIn72. Reports and conversations are not automatically sent to the publisher.
defaultPrompt: Audit my website and explain what works, what needs fixing, and the most useful improvements to make first.
Review my website for mobile usability and enquiries. Show evidence and separate observed problems from hypotheses.
Recheck my website against this previous audit and verify which issues have been fixed.

publication.release_notes: Simplified the directory description to describe the website-audit workflow, report contents and measurement limits. Audit instructions and scoring are unchanged.
